annotation.title_clean: Elements of an instrument and other possible measures to address emerging technologies in the area of LAWS
annotation.title_en: Elements of an instrument and other possible measures to address emerging technologies in the area of LAWS
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bulgaria, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy et al. (submitted to CCW GGE on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.3)
annotation.summary_en: Working paper by several European states to the CCW GGE proposing elements of a future instrument on lethal autonomous weapons using a two-tier approach: prohibit certain LAWS and regulate all others through IHL compliance, human control, testing, risk mitigation and accountability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-tier approach: prohibit certain LAWS, restrict and regulate all others.
Prohibit LAWS that are indiscriminate, uncontrollable in effects, outside human control and chain of command, or cause superfluous injury.
Retain human control across the life cycle, with rules of engagement and limits on time, space and targets.
Require legal reviews, testing, certification, operator training and risk mitigation against bias, loss of control and diversion.
State responsibility and individual responsibility cannot be transferred to machines; national accountability mechanisms required.
